svg.title: dex.place world map, "The Round": side-view map of the final world plan and its pacing curve
svg.desc: Side view of the world to scale in player heights, with regions, rooms, the first-round route, four shortcuts, six shrines and the content destinations; below it, space (vast to cozy) and tension (serene to storm) along the route. The same data is in docs/world/WORLD-PLAN.md sections 3, 5, 6 and 10.
svg.text: Side view, to scale in H (player height, 80 px). x = west to east, y = height; lake surface = 0. Vertical drawn 1.17x. One screen = 16 x 9 H. Room ids match WORLD-PLAN.md.
the ring (west landmark): sun in its hole; a colossus wades the far strand
colossi cross close behind the causeway
the hollow: a city inside a fallen structure
S2 ferry: Pier's End, across the lake and through the culvert (after the lever)
S4 the sky door: balcony latch to the lodge loft
